name: cad
description: IRIN: CAD, robotics, fabrication, and measured engineering validation skills packaged for agent plugin installs.

interface.shortDescription: CAD, robotics, fabrication, and measured engineering validation skills.
interface.longDescription: IRIN packages local agent workflows for generating CAD, inspecting and scoring models against declared engineering assertions, sourcing STEP parts, writing robot description files, slicing mesh files, and preparing fabrication handoffs.
defaultPrompt: Create a CAD model and open it in CAD Viewer.
Generate a URDF and review it locally.
Slice a mesh into printer-ready G-code.
